rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term when something relates to or is made up of syllables, especially in compounds such as 音節結構.

example.english: Syllabic structure is a basic concept in linguistics.
example.traditional: 音節結構係語言學入門一定要識嘅概念。
example.jyutping: jam1 zit3 git3 kau3 hai6 jyu5 jin4 hok6 jap6 mun4 jat1 ding6 jiu3 sik1 ge3 koi3 nim6

rows.note: Use this when describing speech that is pronounced one syllable at a time, as in 逐個音節讀.

example.english: The teacher had me read the new word in a syllabic manner, one syllable at a time.
example.traditional: 老師叫我逐個音節讀呢個生字，唔好讀得咁快。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 giu3 ngo5 zuk6 go3 jam1 zit3 duk6 ni1 go3 saang1 zi6 m4 hou2 duk6 dak1 gam3 faai3

rows.note: Use this when stressing that the syllables themselves are clearly distinct rather than run together.

example.english: When they sing, their delivery is clearly syllabic, so every syllable is easy to hear.
example.traditional: 佢唱歌嗰陣音節分明，完全唔會黐埋一齊。
example.jyutping: keoi5 coeng3 go1 go2 zan6 jam1 zit3 fan1 ming4 jyun4 cyun4 m4 wui5 ci1 maai4 jat1 cai4
